scope: Historical read-only research. No intended wallet, issuer onboarding, signed transactions, allowance mutation or broadcast.

method.discovery: Binance public type=1 BSC inventory; DEXScreener batches of at most 30; 19 discovered stable-paired instruments plus absent blue chips; not exhaustive factory coverage of all issuers or venues.
method.reverseMetric: Independent quote of each buy output back to settlement at the same original block. Not a sequential after-buy round trip; gas omitted.
method.aggregator: GET https://aggregator-api.kyberswap.com/bsc/api/v1/routes. Original previews plus 1.2-second paced RFQ-excluded retries; no route/build or encoded-data simulation.

simulation.override: USDT stateDiff: balance mapping slot 1 and nested owner/spender allowance mapping slot 2, each set to exact requested input and verified with getters. Ephemeral code only at synthetic address.
simulation.effectAlgorithm: Read USDT and stock balanceOf(synthetic), CALL exactInputSingle(router), read both balances again, return router output and four balances. Check full input spend, net stock increase, quote output and router output separately.
simulation.fairValue: Chainlink source updatedAt preserved; 60-second equity age gate retained. Premiums are illustrative stale-round comparisons, not executable price-bound approval.

chainReplayFailure.meaning: Pinned state ceased to be available on supplied endpoint; reran gas control at a fresh pinned block.

aggregatorPacedRfqExcluded.method: Paced public routes, RFQ sources excluded

initialRouterSimulation.syntheticAddressPurpose: No user wallet: temporary eth_call balance/allowance and observer code only

balanceEffectSimulation.syntheticAddressPurpose: No user wallet: temporary eth_call balance/allowance and observer code only
